courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: So in this module, we spend a lot of time on adding authentication and you learned there's a lot to it.
We made sure users can be created,
users can login and then, we're managing this token. We're managing this token with the help of behavior subjects
to make sure that everything in the app updates correctly whenever our token in our user changes.
We're using it in the guard here,
we're using it to find out whether a user is authenticated with the help of our getters there.
We're doing the same for the userId and we're using the token also to append it to the requests we're
sending to our back-end. There, we append the token to every request that leaves our app because otherwise
the back-end as you saw blocks access and this way our back-end is secured and we correctly reflect the
current authentication state on the front-end and we also added things like automatically logging
the user in when it comes back to the app as well as automatically logging the user out.
Now obviously there are rooms for improvement, you can improve error handling, you can use that refresh
token to keep the user logged in for more than one hour.
my goal obviously was to give you an overview
over all these tools and give you a thorough introduction on how you add authentication to an Ionic
Feel free to now explore other options and dive deeper on this to use all the features you need for
